answer.reason: Only one event belongs to Arabia in these verses, its kings bringing gold and silver to Solomon; the other marked verses are prophecies, lists or a trade notice.

clauses.english: sent gold and silver to Solomon through its kings
clauses.quote: kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon

doubts: EZK 30:5 is marked but names Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia and the mingled people, not Arabia, so it was left out.
ISA 21:13 and JER 25:24 are pronouncements and prophecy, not events, so they were left out.
EZK 27:21 gives Arabia's trade in lambs, rams and goats, but the city it traded with is not named in the verses given, so it was left out.
